objective: Add an opt-in bounded Tailscale private shared-brief bridge over the existing isolated state DB, with exact owner/member access identity, login audit, actor-bound retries and only explicit observe/snapshot-brief jobs.
non_goals: No public listener or Funnel, paid/model/market calls, collection, scheduling, approval, U4, paper or production operations.
No production reads, runtime activation, server start, Tailscale changes, commits, pushes or PRs by the implementer.
No unrelated old PR382/Jev changes or source configuration from HTTP.
dependencies: Old b98b686 private identity pattern is reference only, not merged
input_contracts: Optional exact HTTPS *.ts.net:8443 origin and owner login; outside-repository owner-owned mode0600 regular allowlist <=4096 bytes, with safe parents and unique exact member logins.
Tailscale Serve identity arrives from loopback only; duplicate security headers, foreign Host/Origin and wrong identity-bound cookie fail closed.
HTTP jobs contain only command_id and kind; owner and member may run only observe or snapshot-brief over operator-fixed local evidence.
output_artifacts: Scoped uncommitted source, tests, task fixture and short operator documentation.
Login and private job events with actor and actor-bound request hashes in the same isolated workbench DB.
acceptance_tests: Missing/forged/duplicate identities, unsafe allowlists, wrong origins/cookies and all forbidden writes fail before execution; same-actor retry is idempotent, cross-actor reuse conflicts and simultaneous different jobs share one state; existing enabled schedules never execute in private mode.
approval_gates: Design and bounded access scope explicitly approved by Junyan via parent; no new approval inferred from model roles or access login.
Parent performs independent review and any later fresh-state private runtime acceptance; deployment is not part of this implementation.
